positions.name: RememberAsyncDispatchContract
positions.frame: what is the contract for remember's async dispatch and result delivery?
positions.why: All three expressions cohere under one directional read of the ratified async job contract for remember: src-1 states the core contract (receipt in seconds, cursor-watched extraction), src-2 asserts the non-blocking and durability guarantees (no blocking call, no lost work on dropped receipt), and src-3 specifies the dispatch-then-poll-or-piggyback delivery mechanism. Together they span the contract's shape, its guarantees, and its result-delivery paths.
